truth: CORE-01, CORE-03 and CORE-04 are closed as construction dependencies. CORE-02 and PLATFORM-00 remain preserved incomplete.

DAW-00A Peer Host Identity + Runtime Fingerprint is implemented on mergeable draft PR #30 at head 16e1ac9128a06ef27cfa08144fad94ab27a58f14; exact hosts.py passed 15/15 local anti-bias fixtures and hosted exact-head execution is UNOBSERVED.
Global reselection chose DAW-00B because stable workspace identity must exist before FocusContext, Host Shadow, mutation or reconciliation can safely attach to a project.
DAW-00B is the only active increment. Workspace identity is an opaque durable ID owned in the canonical profile database and bound to exactly one Song.
Filesystem/project location, display name, host runtime version and state fingerprint are append-only observations, never workspace identity.
SAME_OR_MOVED and RECOVERED preserve workspace identity. DUPLICATE and FORK create new workspace identities with explicit source lineage.
A currently occupied location cannot merge two workspaces. Once a workspace explicitly moves, its historical old location may be reused by a different workspace without reviving the old identity.

Unknown/SAVE_AS relation is rejected until the caller explicitly chooses the relationship. Existing workspace host family cannot silently change; cross-host continuation requires a fork/new workspace.
Workspace runtime evidence is persisted with the DAW-00A identity payload and fingerprint and is reproducibly revalidated on normal Headquarters reopen.
Workspace history is append-only, workspace identity is immutable, repeated reads are write-free, and explicit workspace observations enter canonical Activity chronology.
The exact workspace semantic harness is green across 16 adversarial cases. Repository regressions are authored; hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
No named DAW adapter, FocusContext, Host Shadow, feature registry, process/project discovery, plugin hosting, DAW mutation or UI implementation is included in DAW-00B.
Historical Ableton identity safety informed the failure class only; no legacy source/test text or Set-specific ownership was copied.
